context.goal: stabilize measurability, reproducibility, and HW efficiency before model expansion

goals: Reduce monitoring overhead without losing diagnostics
Split strict_live vs proxy measurement lane
Replace file polling with event-native runtime
Improve root-cause diagnostics for long runs
Prepare stable baseline for next model matrix expansion
out_of_scope: Large UI redesigns without runtime value
New STT adapters before metrics stabilization
workstreams: WS-A Monitoring budget and scan policy

phases.title: Baseline and instrumentation lock
dod: All later phases use same measurement protocol

phases.title: Monitoring budget and phased scanning
dod: Measured CPU overhead drop vs baseline

phases.title: Latency discipline split
dod: No mixed latency classes in decision outputs
Live best-model derived from live-valid metrics only

phases.title: Event-store orchestration
dod: File polling is no longer primary runtime channel
Timeline and state reconstruction are available

phases.title: Release gate and rollout
dod: Next expansion steps are explicitly allowed

risks.mitigation: minimum signal contract and explicit full-scan escalation
phase owner and DoD gates per milestone

acceptance_criteria: Live decision lane is methodologically clean
Runtime telemetry flow is event-native and auditable
Reproducibility and diagnostics improve over baseline
